facts.text: I am considering pursuing a certification in digital marketing.
I narrowed my digital marketing certification options down to two programs.
I attended my colleague Alex's graduation from a leadership development program at work a few weeks ago.
One of the programs is offered by HubSpot.
The other program is offered by the Digital Marketing Institute.
Both programs are online and self-paced.
The Digital Marketing Institute program costs around $5,000.
Both programs cover similar topics including SEO, social media, and email marketing.
I am unsure about the industry recognition of the HubSpot program.
I want to compare the recognition of the HubSpot certification to the Digital Marketing Institute certification.
I am concerned about the cost of the Digital Marketing Institute program.
I want to know whether there are financing options or scholarships available for the $5,000 tuition.
I want to know the payment plan options for the Digital Marketing Institute program.
I want to know how the Digital Marketing Institute payment plan works.
I want to know whether the Digital Marketing Institute payment plan has additional fees or interest rates.
I want to know more about the career support provided by the Digital Marketing Institute.
I want to know what kind of job placement assistance I can expect from the Digital Marketing Institute.
I want to know whether there are notable alumni or industry connections from the Digital Marketing Institute that can help my career.

keyphrases: payment plan options interest rates fees
